blocks.text:
Instead of travelling by bus, you can choose the luxury **Titicaca Train**.

It runs from Cusco to Puno on **Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays**.

Lunch in the dining car includes a starter, main course and dessert. Wine can be ordered at the bar.

The route includes a stop at **La Raya**, at **4,319 metres**, the highest point of the journey.

Arrival in Puno is around **19:00**.

**Supplement:** $3 per person.

blocks.text: Day 7 · After breakfast, a day on Lake Titicaca, at about 3,810 m, the subject of many legends: dozens of floating reed islands, the Uros Islands, are home to islanders who live from fishing, tourism and crafts, weaving baskets, furniture and even boats, on which you can ride around the lake. Continue to Taquile Island, whose weaving was proclaimed a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO in 2005. Lunch on the island and return to Puno.
